cohort: 614 nulliparous Omani women with singleton pregnancies (307 teenagers aged 14-19 years and 307 women aged 20-25 years)
finding: Teenage pregnant Omani women had a higher risk of preterm delivery before 32 weeks gestation, PPROM, anemia, and delivering very low birth weight babies compared to women aged 20-25 years.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was lower in teenage girls than women (10% vs. 20%).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was lower in babies born to teenage girls (2750g vs. 2890g)
